_note: Single-source (Ancient Egyptian: Old-Kingdom culture/architecture + New-Kingdom military). Egyptian (Afro-Asiatic) sub-palette. civ = feudal (the god-king/temple bureaucracy is narrative flavor over a feudal realm). Even split Neutral/Chaotic. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Egyptian register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are phoneme-morphs of the canonical (Agrippan) pantheon through Egyptian phonology (gdd-naming-conventions 5), never real Egyptian gods.

phonology.palette: Egyptian: dj, tj, kh, h, sh, q; l tends to r; v tends to w; endings -aa/-et; vowels a e i o u (reconstructed); theophoric stems are morphed canon-names (Tjuraa-, Djeroraa-, Riaret-, Mery-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; clusters dj/tj/kh; long -aa; stress varies.

morphology.patronymic_form: filiation 'sa' (son of); theophoric given names (on morphed god-stems); no inherited surname (filiation + epithet instead).
morphology.compounding_rule: construct: Per-[god] (house/temple of), Niut-[god] (city of), Pa-[noun] (the-); quality + feature: Kemu-niut (black-land city).

title_ladder.government: feudal (Egyptian; the divine-kingship and nomarch bureaucracy is narrative flavor)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Egyptian, ascending. Hatia (mayor) barony; Wer-khaset (great-one of the frontier-land) march; Sepati/Sepat (nomarch/nome) county; Mer-mesha (army-overseer/general) duchy; Heqa-aa (great ruler) principality; Nesut (king) kingdom; Per-aa (Pharaoh, lit. the Great House) empire over the Per-aat. (Rank titles are the real Egyptian register, allowed.)
title_ladder.heir: Sa-Nesut (king's son / crown prince); Iry-pat (hereditary heir)

people_name_convention.order: given (often theophoric) + filiation (sa-X) and/or earned epithet; no inherited surname.
people_name_convention.dual_register: officials append office-titles; commoners use filiation + epithet.
people_name_convention.theophoric: given names built from the morphed deity-names + a common Egyptian element: X-hotep (X-is-content), X-mose (X-is-born), Mery-X (beloved-of-X), Sa-X (son-of-X). e.g. Tjuraa-hotep, Mery-Djeroraa.

religion._note: Deity-names are phoneme-morphs of the canonical (Agrippan) pantheon through Egyptian phonology (l -> r; v -> w; -us/-a -> -aa/-et; dj/tj/kh flavor) — recognizably the same powers, never real Egyptian gods. Neutral/Chaotic; strong funerary cult and god-king ideology.
religion.the_one: Atjernaa (< Aeternus; the hidden distant maker, honored not petitioned)
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: each opposing power keeps its morphed name + its own portfolio epithet (distinct per power; framed as -kin of the great serpent Hefau): Maraxus -> Marakhu the City-Burner; Raptis -> Rapetj the Red; Vacidus -> Wakedjet, the Devouring Hefau.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Per-netjer (god's-house/temple) of [power]: 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified dead (akhu) and god-kings, venerated at tomb-temples; 'the justified [name]' (maa-kheru).

holy_symbol_motifs.Tjuraa: sun-disc above the feather of right-order
holy_symbol_motifs.Djeroraa: crook and flail over a tomb-pylon

banks_patterns.ships: solar-barque names: 'Barque of Tjuraa', 'Beloved of the River'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [god] Division / the [name] Companies: 'the Division of Rapetj'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: tombs and pyramids of the god-kings: 'the Tomb of Per-aa [name]', 'the Sunken Per-netjer'
